notes: Sloka 13: marriage may come in the dasha of a planet in, aspecting or ruling the 7th house. Applied to both dasha and sub-period lords.

rules.text: The dasha lord occupies, aspects or rules the 7th house: a period in which marriage may come.
The sub-period lord occupies, aspects or rules the 7th house: a sub-period in which marriage may come.
